thesis: The site is the garage floor coming back: every section removes one layer of clutter from a top-down plan until the slab is bare and the car fits again.

signature.name: Clearing Floor Plan
signature.summary: Top-down SVG garage outline in left margin (desktop) or sticky pill row (mobile); item silhouettes lift off per section via clip-path revealing sand-colored concrete and a typed destination label. Empty plan + car outline at footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='floor-plan'.

motion.intro: Ramp line draws from truck-bed height to driveway; headline slides down it into place. ≤1.2 s, skippable.
stories: Pinned clearing floor plan (desktop): 6 process steps lift item outlines one per step. Mobile: stacked cards with clip-reveal.
Load Sizer truck-bed fill: tapping items fills silhouette proportionally. Inline, no pin.
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left via scaleX(0)→scaleX(1) under links and buttons.
